verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered agent service page confirms core RA functionality: alerts when official mail arrives, unlimited cloud storage for documents, and assistance switching agents, which supports the founder-story premise of receiving legal mail digitally. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming scanned copies of service of process specifically or digital delivery mechanics (scan speed, dashboard viewing), and no independent/hands-on corroboration of the mail-forwarding experience. missing for 10: explicit mention of 'service of process' handling, description of scanning/digitization process, independent user reports confirming reliability of mail alerts.
